mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in GDPC1, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 YoY growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market that will drive wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: UNRATE drops below 5% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a supply shock that will drive inflation higher and lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: INDPRO YoY growth drops below -2% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) rise above a 1.2 million unit annualized rate, it signals a strengthening housing market that will boost consumer spending and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST rises above 1.2 million units but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises above 4%, it signals a tightening monetary policy that will slow economic growth and lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS rises above 4% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real estate loans (RSAFS) grow by more than 10% year-over-year, it signals an overextended credit market that will lead to a slowdown in consumer spending and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS YoY growth exceeds 10% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by less than 100,000 jobs per month for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that will slow economic growth and lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS monthly change < 100,000 for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: PAYEMS monthly change < 100,000 for 2 months but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) rises by more than 3% year-over-year, it signals high inflation that will erode consumer purchasing power and lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 3% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.
